purpose: Keep the public Ask the Model landing page consistent with the implemented application/provider/model boundary and the current public release without reducing the first-time-user detail that the application README intentionally provides.

suite_visual_identity.note: AtM intentionally has a second action row because it is an installable application. Scientific-model repositories keep only the primary identity row.

implemented_capabilities: loopback-only provider addressing in the current provider implementation
required_boundaries: AtM is the interface; the local provider runs the AI model.
AI model files are separate artifacts and must currently be downloaded/managed outside AtM.
AtM discovers models through the provider; it does not scan arbitrary disks for GGUF files.
AtM does not currently download, import, move, update or delete AI models.
Repository/retrieval backend work on development main remains unreleased and is not exposed through the public v0.2.2 GTK repository-selection, grounded-chat or citation flow.
Scientific repositories remain authoritative for their code, data, assumptions, provenance and validation.
AtM must not present AI-generated text as a canonical scientific-model result without repository-grounded provenance or actual model execution.

release_vs_development_boundary.public_release: v0.2.2 remains local-chat only from an end-user perspective.
release_vs_development_boundary.development_main: Unreleased repository/retrieval backend work may exist on main without changing the current public release capability boundary.
release_vs_development_boundary.readme_rule: README statements about repository retrieval must distinguish released user-facing behavior from development-main backend implementation.
